task: Generate a single black-and-white coloring-page line art image.
how_to_use: Send this JSON first. Then send a second message with ONLY the subject to draw, e.g. 'Unicorn'. Draw that subject following every rule below.
subject: {SUBJECT_FROM_NEXT_MESSAGE}
audience: Toddlers aged 1-4. The art must be simple, big, and cheerful.

style.look: cute kawaii cartoon, friendly, rounded, chubby proportions, big happy face if the subject has a face
style.linework: thick, bold, clean, solid black outlines of even weight
style.composition: one subject, centered, large, with comfortable empty white margin around it
style.detail_level: minimal — few large simple shapes, no fine or busy detail

hard_requirements: Pure black outlines (#000000) on a pure white (#FFFFFF) background only.
Every shape must be FULLY CLOSED — no gaps or breaks in any outline. Lines that should meet must connect completely.
Outlines must be THICK (bold) so they never look thin or faint.
Use LARGE, well-separated fillable areas. Each area a toddler could tap and color.
Keep the total number of separate regions small (roughly 8-20).
Leave clear white space between the subject and the image edges.
Flat 2D front-facing or simple side view. No perspective, no overlap clutter.
must_not: No shading, no gray tones, no gradients.
No color of any kind — black and white only.
No fills, no solid black areas (outlines only; interiors stay white).
No textures, hatching, stippling, or patterns inside shapes.
No background scenery unless it is a few large simple closed shapes (e.g. one cloud, one ground line).
No text, no letters, no watermark, no signature, no border frame.
No tiny details (eyelashes, fur strands, sparkles clusters) that create tiny regions.
No open/broken lines, no sketchy or double lines, no dashed lines.

output.resolution: highest available, target ~1024-1536 px per side

self_check_before_finishing: Are ALL outlines fully closed with no gaps? (critical)
Are the lines thick and solid black?
Is the background pure white with no shading?
Are there only a handful of big, easy-to-color regions?
Is it a single centered subject with white margin?

example.expected: A single centered cute kawaii baby unicorn with thick closed black outlines: rounded body, big head with a small smile and dot eyes, a horn, a large curly mane and tail as big closed shapes, chunky legs, on pure white. Maybe one simple closed cloud or star. No shading, no color, few large regions.
